definitions.name: Paladin
definitions.summary: Holy warrior sworn to an oath, with smites and healing hands.

definitions.name: Fighting Style
definitions.summary: Pick a fighting style at 2nd level. Tasha's adds Blessed Warrior, Blind Fighting and Interception to the paladin's options.

definitions.name: Additional Paladin Spells
definitions.summary: Tasha's adds more spells to the paladin spell list (e.g. Ceremony, Warding Bond, Aura of Vitality, Spirit Shroud, Summon Celestial).

definitions.name: Harness Divine Power
definitions.summary: Bonus action: spend a Channel Divinity use to regain one expended spell slot of a level up to half your proficiency bonus (round up). Usable once per long rest, twice from 7th level and three times from 15th.

actions.name: Harness Divine Power
actions.note: Spend Channel Divinity: regain a spell slot of level up to half your proficiency bonus (round up). Also mark a Harness Divine Power use.

definitions.name: Martial Versatility
definitions.summary: When you gain an Ability Score Improvement, you can swap your fighting style for another one the paladin can take.

definitions.name: Blessed Warrior
definitions.summary: Fighting style: learn two cleric cantrips; they count as paladin spells (Charisma). You can swap one when you gain a paladin level.

definitions.name: Oath of the Ancients
definitions.summary: Paladin sworn to protect light, life and the beauty of the natural world.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (3)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (5)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Moonbeam, Misty Step.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (9)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Plant Growth, Protection from Energy.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (13)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Ice Storm, Stoneskin.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (17)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
definitions.summary: Action, Channel Divinity: spectral vines try to restrain a creature within 10 ft; it makes a Strength or Dexterity save (its choice) and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Nature's Wrath
actions.note: One creature within 10 ft: Strength or Dexterity save or restrained; it repeats the save each turn.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
definitions.summary: Action, Channel Divinity: fey and fiends within 30 ft that hear you make a Wisdom save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged; disguised ones are revealed.

actions.name: Turn the Faithless
actions.note: Fey and fiends within 30 ft: Wisdom save or turned for 1 minute (ends if damaged).

definitions.name: Aura of Warding
definitions.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) have resistance to damage from spells.

definitions.name: Undying Sentinel
definitions.summary: Once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, you drop to 1 HP instead. You also stop showing the effects of age and can't be aged magically.

actions.name: Undying Sentinel
actions.note: You would drop to 0 HP (and not die outright): drop to 1 HP instead.

definitions.name: Elder Champion
definitions.summary: Action, once per long rest, 1 minute: regain 10 HP at the start of each of your turns, cast paladin spells that take an action as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 ft have disadvantage on saves against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity.

actions.name: Elder Champion
actions.note: 1 minute: regain 10 HP each turn start, action paladin spells as a bonus action, nearby enemies have disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity.

definitions.name: Oath of Vengeance
definitions.summary: Paladin sworn to punish those who commit grievous sins, at any cost.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (3)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Bane, Hunter's Mark.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (5)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Hold Person, Misty Step.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (9)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Haste, Protection from Energy.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (13)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Banishment, Dimension Door.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (17)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Hold Monster, Scrying.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
definitions.summary: Action, Channel Divinity: one creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save (fiends and undead at disadvantage). On a fail it is frightened and its speed is 0 for 1 minute or until damaged; on a success its speed is halved for 1 minute.

actions.name: Abjure Enemy
actions.note: One creature within 60 ft: Wisdom save or frightened with speed 0 for 1 minute (ends if damaged); half speed on a success.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
definitions.summary: Bonus action, Channel Divinity: choose a creature within 10 ft; you have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP or falls unconscious.

actions.name: Vow of Enmity
actions.note: Advantage on attacks against one creature within 10 ft for 1 minute.

when.text: attacking the creature you vowed against

definitions.name: Relentless Avenger
definitions.summary: When you hit with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed right after it as part of the same reaction, without provoking opportunity attacks.

modifiers.label: Relentless Avenger: if this opportunity attack hits, move up to half your speed without provoking.

definitions.name: Soul of Vengeance
definitions.summary: When the creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it if it's in range.

actions.name: Soul of Vengeance
actions.note: The creature under your Vow of Enmity attacks: make one melee weapon attack against it.

definitions.name: Avenging Angel
definitions.summary: Action, once per long rest, 1 hour: you sprout wings (flying speed 60 ft) and project a 30-ft aura; enemies entering or starting their turn in it make a Wisdom save or are frightened for 1 minute or until damaged, and attacks against them have advantage.

actions.name: Avenging Angel
actions.note: 1 hour: fly 60 ft and a 30-ft menacing aura (Wisdom save or frightened; attacks against them have advantage).

definitions.name: Oath of Conquest
definitions.summary: Paladin who seeks glory by crushing chaos and ruling through fear.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (3)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Armor of Agathys, Command.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (5)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (9)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Bestow Curse, Fear.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (13)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Dominate Beast, Stoneskin.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (17)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Cloudkill, Dominate Person.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
definitions.summary: Action, Channel Divinity: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a Wisdom save or are frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of their turns.

actions.name: Conquering Presence
actions.note: Chosen creatures within 30 ft: Wisdom save or frightened for 1 minute (save again each turn).

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
definitions.summary: Channel Divinity: after seeing your attack roll but before knowing if it hits, add +10 to it.

actions.name: Guided Strike
actions.note: +10 to an attack roll you just made, before you know if it hits.

definitions.name: Aura of Conquest
definitions.summary: Creatures frightened of you within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) have speed 0 and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level when they start their turn there.

definitions.name: Scornful Rebuke
definitions.summary: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (at least 1), unless you're incapacitated.

definitions.name: Invincible Conqueror
definitions.summary: Action, once per long rest, 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one extra attack when you take the Attack action, and your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on 19 or 20.

actions.name: Invincible Conqueror
actions.note: 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one more attack in your Attack action, melee crits on 19-20.

definitions.name: Oath of Redemption
definitions.summary: Paladin who favors peace and persuasion, using violence only as a last resort.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (3)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Sanctuary, Sleep.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (5)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Calm Emotions, Hold Person.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (9)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Counterspell, Hypnotic Pattern.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (13)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere, Stoneskin.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (17)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Hold Monster, Wall of Force.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
definitions.summary: Bonus action, Channel Divinity: +5 to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 10 minutes.

actions.name: Emissary of Peace
actions.note: +5 to Persuasion checks for 10 minutes.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
definitions.summary: Reaction, Channel Divinity: when a creature within 30 ft damages someone other than you, it makes a Wisdom save, taking radiant damage equal to the damage it dealt (half on a success).

actions.name: Rebuke the Violent
actions.note: An attacker within 30 ft hurts someone else: Wisdom save, radiant damage equal to what it dealt (half on success).

definitions.name: Aura of the Guardian
definitions.summary: Reaction: when a creature within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) takes damage, you take that damage instead; it can't be reduced or prevented.

actions.name: Aura of the Guardian
actions.note: A creature within 10 ft takes damage: you take it instead (no reduction).

definitions.name: Protective Spirit
definitions.summary: At the end of each of your turns, if you are below half your hit points and not incapacitated, you regain 1d6 + half your paladin level in hit points.

actions.name: Protective Spirit
actions.note: End of your turn, below half HP and not incapacitated: regain 1d6 + half your paladin level.

definitions.name: Emissary of Redemption
definitions.summary: You resist all damage dealt by other creatures, and anyone who damages you takes radiant damage equal to half of it. Both stop working against a creature you attack or target with a spell, until your next long rest.

definitions.name: Oath of Glory
definitions.summary: Paladin who believes they and their allies are destined for heroic deeds.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (3)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Guiding Bolt, Heroism.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (5)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (9)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Haste, Protection from Energy.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (13)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (17)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Commune, Flame Strike.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
definitions.summary: Bonus action, Channel Divinity, 10 minutes: advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks, double carrying capacity, and longer jumps.

actions.name: Peerless Athlete
actions.note: 10 minutes: advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, carry more, jump farther.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
definitions.summary: Bonus action right after a Divine Smite, Channel Divinity: roll 2d8 + your paladin level and share that many temporary HP among creatures of your choice within 30 ft (you included).

actions.name: Inspiring Smite
actions.note: Right after a Divine Smite: split the rolled temp HP among creatures within 30 ft.

definitions.name: Aura of Alacrity
definitions.summary: Your walking speed rises by 10 ft. Allies who start their turn within 5 ft of you (10 ft at 18th level) also gain +10 ft until the end of that turn.

definitions.name: Glorious Defense
definitions.summary: Reaction, Charisma modifier times per long rest (at least once): when you or a creature within 10 ft is hit, add your Charisma modifier to its AC against that attack; if it then misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker.

actions.name: Glorious Defense
actions.note: You or a creature within 10 ft is hit: +CHA mod to its AC; on a miss, make one weapon attack against the attacker.

definitions.name: Living Legend
definitions.summary: Bonus action, 1 minute, once per long rest (or by spending a 5th-level slot): advantage on Charisma checks, once per turn turn a missed weapon attack into a hit, and use your reaction to reroll a failed save.

actions.name: Living Legend
actions.note: 1 minute: advantage on Charisma checks, once per turn a missed weapon attack hits, reaction to reroll a failed save. Can also be fuelled by a 5th-level slot.

modifiers.label: Living Legend: once per turn, a miss can become a hit.

definitions.name: Oath of the Watchers
definitions.summary: Paladin who guards the world against threats from beyond the Material Plane.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (3)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Alarm, Detect Magic.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (5)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Moonbeam, See Invisibility.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (9)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Counterspell, Nondetection.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (13)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Aura of Purity, Banishment.

definitions.name: Oath Spells (17)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, and they don't count against the spells you prepare: Hold Monster, Scrying.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
definitions.summary: Action, Channel Divinity: up to your Charisma modifier (at least 1) creatures within 30 ft, you included, get advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves for 1 minute.

actions.name: Watcher's Will
actions.note: 1 minute: chosen creatures (you included) get advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar
definitions.summary: Action, Channel Divinity: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends within 30 ft that hear you make a Wisdom save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged.

actions.name: Abjure the Extraplanar
actions.note: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends within 30 ft: Wisdom save or turned for 1 minute (ends if damaged).

definitions.name: Aura of the Sentinel
definitions.summary: You and creatures of your choice within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

definitions.name: Vigilant Rebuke
definitions.summary: Reaction: when you or a creature within 30 ft succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save, the creature that forced it takes 2d8 + your Charisma modifier force damage.

actions.name: Vigilant Rebuke
actions.note: A mental save succeeds near you: the creature that forced it takes force damage.

definitions.name: Mortal Bulwark
definitions.summary: Bonus action, 1 minute, once per long rest (or by spending a 5th-level slot): truesight 120 ft, advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and a hit can force such a creature to make a Charisma save or be banished to its home plane.

actions.name: Mortal Bulwark
actions.note: 1 minute: truesight 120 ft, advantage against extraplanar creatures, hits can banish them (Charisma save). Can also be fuelled by a 5th-level slot.

when.text: target is one of aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends
